info.prompt: Isometric breakdown of a Heist in progress: seventy percent of scored points flow upward as crimson data streams into a suspended vault hologram while the thief's avatar—a violet-amber geometric construct—initiates the five-second heist window, their energy bar draining rapidly as other players' role abilities activate—Headhunter's claw interface lunging to block, Archivist's shield shimmering—all rendered in the game's signature translucent ice-stone materiality with neon cyan stress fractures spiderwebbing across the vault's surface
